[[Image:MilanDamnjanovic.jpg|thumb|Milan Damnjanović]]
{{Short description|Serbian professor of Quantum mechanics and Mathematical physics (born 1953)}}
'''Milan Damnjanović''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: Милан Дамњановић) (born July 9, 1953), is a full professor specialising in [[Quantum mechanics]] and [[Mathematical physics]] at the [[University of Belgrade#Physics|Faculty of Physics]] at the [[University of Belgrade]] and Member of [[Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts]].
